name: YS LeadGen – AI Popup Builder, Lead Generation Forms & Marketing Popups
author: YS Innovations

sections.description:
Every website gets visitors—but not every visitor becomes a subscriber, lead, or customer.

YS LeadGen is a powerful popup builder and lead generation plugin that helps you convert visitors into subscribers, qualified leads, and customers using beautiful popups, smart forms, and conversion-focused marketing campaigns.

Whether you run a WooCommerce store, business website, blog, agency, SaaS product, online course, portfolio, or local business, YS LeadGen makes it easy to create professional campaigns without writing code.

Build popups in minutes with the intuitive drag-and-drop builder, professionally designed templates, advanced targeting rules, AI-powered content generation, and seamless integrations with popular email marketing platforms.

Unlike hosted popup services, YS LeadGen runs entirely on your WordPress website, giving you full control over your campaigns, customer data, and performance.

Whether your goal is growing your email list, generating leads, promoting special offers, increasing WooCommerce sales, or collecting customer feedback, YS LeadGen provides everything you need to create high-converting campaigns from a single plugin.

Quick Links

  • Live Demo
  • Documentation
  • Templates
  • Pricing
  • Changelog
  • Support

Why Choose YS LeadGen?

Your website should do more than attract visitors—it should convert them.

YS LeadGen combines a powerful popup builder, lead generation forms, AI-powered content generation, WooCommerce marketing tools, advanced targeting, analytics, and automation into one complete conversion optimization plugin.

Instead of installing multiple plugins for popups, forms, surveys, countdown timers, cookie consent, analytics, and WooCommerce campaigns, you can manage everything from a single, easy-to-use dashboard.

No coding required.

No monthly platform fees.

Just powerful marketing tools that help you convert more visitors into subscribers, leads, and customers.

Grow Your Business

✔ Grow your email list with beautiful newsletter popups.

✔ Capture more leads using customizable lead generation forms.

✔ Recover abandoning visitors with Exit Intent campaigns.

✔ Increase WooCommerce sales using coupons, upsells, cross-sells, and product recommendations.

✔ Promote product launches, seasonal offers, and special announcements.

✔ Collect customer feedback using Surveys and NPS forms.

✔ Build trust with Social Proof notifications.

✔ Promote videos, lead magnets, downloads, and webinars.

✔ Display personalized campaigns using smart targeting rules.

✔ Launch professional campaigns in minutes with ready-to-use templates.

Perfect For

YS LeadGen is designed for every type of WordPress website.

It is perfect for:

  • WooCommerce Stores
  • Small Businesses
  • Digital Agencies
  • Marketing Agencies
  • Bloggers
  • Affiliate Marketers
  • SaaS Companies
  • Startups
  • Freelancers
  • Coaches & Consultants
  • Online Courses
  • Membership Websites
  • Local Businesses
  • Real Estate Agencies
  • Healthcare Clinics

  • Non-Profit Organizations
  • Content Creators

Everything You Need to Grow Your Business

YS LeadGen combines everything you need to create high-converting marketing campaigns in one powerful WordPress plugin.

Instead of installing multiple plugins for popups, forms, surveys, countdown timers, WooCommerce promotions, cookie consent, analytics, and email marketing, YS LeadGen brings everything together in a single, easy-to-use solution.

Whether you’re growing your email list, generating leads, increasing sales, or engaging your visitors, YS LeadGen provides the tools you need to build campaigns that deliver real results.

What Can You Build with YS LeadGen?

Every website has different marketing goals, and YS LeadGen gives you the flexibility to create campaigns that match them.

Whether you’re collecting email subscribers, generating qualified leads, promoting products, increasing WooCommerce sales, or collecting customer feedback, you can build professional campaigns in just a few minutes.

Choose from professionally designed templates or build your own campaigns from scratch using the visual drag-and-drop builder.

Grow Your Email List

Turn visitors into loyal subscribers with beautiful newsletter popups and email signup forms.

Automatically connect subscribers with your favorite email marketing platform and start building your audience.

Perfect for:

  • Blogs
  • News Websites
  • Content Creators
  • Online Courses
  • Membership Websites
  • SaaS Businesses

Generate More Leads

Create high-converting lead generation forms that encourage visitors to request quotes, schedule consultations, download resources, or contact your business.

Build simple forms or advanced multi-step forms without writing code.

Perfect for:

  • Agencies
  • Local Businesses
  • Real Estate
  • Healthcare
  • Education
  • Professional Services

Increase WooCommerce Sales

Create personalized marketing campaigns that help convert more visitors into customers.

Promote discount coupons, recommend products, recover abandoning visitors, announce free shipping, and display targeted offers based on customer behavior.

Perfect for:

  • Fashion Stores
  • Electronics
  • Beauty Products
  • Home & Living
  • Digital Products
  • Subscription Businesses

Promote Special Offers

Create urgency using countdown timers, flash sales, seasonal promotions, product launches, and limited-time campaigns that encourage visitors to take action before the offer expires.

Perfect for:

  • Black Friday
  • Cyber Monday
  • Holiday Sales
  • Festival Campaigns
  • Product Launches
  • Flash Sales

Collect Customer Feedback

Understand your visitors with surveys, polls, feedback forms, and Net Promoter Score (NPS) campaigns.

Gather valuable insights to improve your products, services, and customer experience.

Promote Videos & Announcements

Display YouTube, Vimeo, or self-hosted videos inside beautiful popup campaigns.

Perfect for webinars, tutorials, product launches, feature announcements, and promotional videos.

Offer Lead Magnets

Grow your subscriber list by offering downloadable resources such as eBooks, templates, guides, checklists, coupons, or exclusive content in exchange for an email address.

Content Locker campaigns help turn your best content into a powerful lead generation tool.

Popup Types

Choose the perfect popup for every marketing goal.

Lightbox Popup

Display beautiful modal popups that immediately capture your visitors’ attention.

Lead Generation Popup

Capture enquiries, bookings, quote requests, and customer information using customizable lead generation forms.

Newsletter Popup

Grow your email list with attractive newsletter signup forms connected to your preferred email marketing service.

Exit Intent Popup

Recover abandoning visitors before they leave your website by displaying targeted offers and lead capture forms.

Coupon Popup

Increase conversions by displaying discount codes and special offers at the perfect moment.

Countdown Timer Popup

Create urgency for flash sales, seasonal campaigns, product launches, and limited-time promotions.

Spin-to-Win Popup

Increase engagement with interactive gamification campaigns that reward visitors with discounts and special offers.

Slide-In Popup

Display subtle promotional messages from the corner of the screen without interrupting the browsing experience.

Floating Bar

Highlight announcements, coupon codes, free shipping offers, and important notices using a sticky notification bar.

Full Screen Popup

Create immersive campaigns that maximize attention for promotions, product launches, and lead generation.

Video Popup

Embed YouTube, Vimeo, or self-hosted videos to increase engagement and showcase your products or services.

Survey Popup

Collect customer opinions, product feedback, and satisfaction scores using interactive survey campaigns.

NPS Popup

Measure customer loyalty with simple Net Promoter Score campaigns.

Social Proof Popup

Build trust by displaying recent purchases, new subscribers, customer reviews, and other real-time activity.

Content Locker

Protect premium content and encourage visitors to subscribe before accessing valuable resources.

Age Verification Popup

Restrict age-sensitive content using customizable age verification campaigns.

Cookie Consent Banner

Help visitors manage cookie preferences while supporting privacy compliance.

Design Beautiful Popups Without Coding

Creating professional popup campaigns shouldn’t require technical skills.

YS LeadGen includes an intuitive drag-and-drop popup builder that makes it easy to design, customize, and publish campaigns in just a few minutes.

Customize layouts, typography, colors, buttons, backgrounds, images, forms, animations, spacing, overlays, and much more—all through a simple visual editor.

Whether you’re creating a newsletter popup, lead generation campaign, or WooCommerce promotion, you have complete creative control without touching a single line of code.

Builder Highlights

  • Drag & Drop Popup Builder
  • Professionally Designed Templates
  • Live Preview
  • Responsive Layouts
  • Mobile-Friendly Design
  • Multi-Step Campaign Builder
  • Unlimited Design Customization
  • Custom Colors & Typography
  • Background Images & Videos
  • Button & CTA Customization
  • Custom CSS & JavaScript

  • Reusable Templates
  • Fast & Lightweight Performance

Show the Right Message at the Right Time

A great popup isn’t just about design—it’s about showing the right message to the right visitor at the right moment.

YS LeadGen gives you complete control over when, where, and to whom your campaigns appear. Create personalized experiences based on visitor behavior, page content, WooCommerce activity, devices, and more to improve engagement and increase conversions.

Whether you’re welcoming first-time visitors, recovering abandoning shoppers, promoting special offers, or growing your email list, YS LeadGen helps you deliver more relevant campaigns.

Smart Display Triggers

Launch campaigns based on visitor actions and behavior.

  • Page Load
  • User Inactivity
  • Click Trigger

  • Image Click
  • Custom CSS Selector
  • After Comment

Fine-tune exactly how every campaign behaves.

  • Display Delay

  • Unlimited Display Rules

Deliver more personalized experiences while avoiding unnecessary interruptions for your visitors.

Work Smarter with AI

Creating high-converting campaigns doesn’t have to start with a blank page.

YS LeadGen includes built-in AI tools that help you create better campaigns faster. Generate compelling headlines, persuasive calls to action, and campaign ideas in seconds.

Whether you’re promoting a sale, collecting leads, or launching a new product, AI helps you create professional marketing campaigns with less effort.

AI Features

  • AI Campaign Suggestions
  • Smart Template Recommendations

  • Marketing Copy Generator
  • Popup Content Ideas
  • Campaign Optimization Suggestions
  • Faster Campaign Creation
  • Reduce Writer’s Block

AI helps you create better campaigns while keeping you in full control of your content.

Built for WooCommerce Growth

Turn your WooCommerce store into a powerful conversion machine.

YS LeadGen helps you increase sales, reduce cart abandonment, promote offers, and create personalized shopping experiences using smart popup campaigns.

Whether you’re running a small online shop or a large eCommerce business, YS LeadGen helps you engage shoppers at every stage of the buying journey.

  • Revenue Analytics

Promote the right products at the right time and encourage customers to complete more purchases.

Build High-Converting Forms

Create beautiful forms that help you capture leads, enquiries, registrations, bookings, feedback, and newsletter subscribers.

Design simple contact forms or advanced multi-step forms without installing additional plugins.

Form Builder Features

Collect the information you need while providing a smooth experience for your visitors.

Connect with Your Favorite Marketing Tools

YS LeadGen works seamlessly with the most popular email marketing platforms and automation services.

Automatically sync new subscribers and leads with your existing marketing workflow.

Email Marketing Integrations

  • Brevo
  • Klaviyo

  • ActiveCampaign
  • GetResponse
  • Drip
  • Webhooks
  • CSV Export

We’re continuously adding new integrations to help you connect with even more marketing platforms.

Measure What Matters

Successful marketing isn’t about guesswork—it’s about understanding what works.

YS LeadGen includes built-in analytics that help you measure campaign performance, identify your highest-converting popups, and make smarter marketing decisions.

Track important metrics, discover which campaigns generate the most leads, and continuously optimize your conversion rates using real data.

Analytics & Reporting

  • Popup Views
  • Form Submissions
  • Conversions
  • Conversion Rate
  • Campaign Performance
  • Top Performing Campaigns
  • Revenue Analytics (WooCommerce)
  • Subscriber Growth
  • Lead Reports
  • Export Reports

Use detailed insights to improve every campaign and maximize your marketing results.

Built for Performance

Fast websites create better user experiences and higher conversion rates.

YS LeadGen is built with performance in mind, ensuring your popup campaigns load efficiently without slowing down your website.

Performance Features

  • Lightweight Frontend Assets
  • Optimized CSS & JavaScript
  • Responsive by Default
  • Lazy Loading Support
  • Mobile Optimized
  • SEO Friendly
  • Clean Codebase
  • Regular Performance Improvements

Create engaging campaigns while maintaining excellent website performance.

Privacy & Compliance

Respect your visitors’ privacy while collecting valuable customer information.

YS LeadGen includes privacy-focused features that help support GDPR and other privacy regulations.

Privacy Features

  • Cookie Consent Banner
  • Privacy Policy Acceptance
  • GDPR-Friendly Forms
  • Consent Checkboxes
  • Cookie-Based Display Rules
  • Spam Protection
  • Secure Form Validation
  • Data Collection Controls

Always review your local legal requirements to ensure your website complies with applicable privacy laws.

Why Businesses Choose YS LeadGen

Thousands of businesses use popup campaigns to generate leads, increase sales, and grow their audience.

YS LeadGen combines a modern popup builder, lead generation forms, AI-powered content tools, advanced targeting, WooCommerce marketing features, analytics, and automation into one complete conversion optimization platform.

Whether you’re growing an email list, generating qualified leads, increasing WooCommerce revenue, promoting seasonal offers, launching new products, or collecting customer feedback, YS LeadGen provides the flexibility to create campaigns that match your business goals.

From bloggers and creators to agencies, online stores, SaaS companies, educators, and local businesses, YS LeadGen helps businesses of every size convert more visitors into customers.

Privacy

YS LeadGen runs entirely on your WordPress website.

The plugin does not collect personal information unless you configure forms or connect third-party services.

Depending on the integrations you enable, visitor information may be processed by third-party email marketing platforms or marketing services that you choose to connect.

You remain in full control of your website data, customer information, and marketing campaigns.

Review your website’s privacy policy and applicable regulations to ensure compliance with local privacy laws.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the YS LeadGen plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install it directly from the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open YS LeadGen from your WordPress dashboard.
  4. Create your first popup using the drag-and-drop builder.
  5. Configure your display rules and targeting options.
  6. Publish your campaign and start converting visitors into subscribers, leads, and customers.
sections.faq:
Is YS LeadGen beginner friendly?

Yes. You can create your first popup in just a few minutes using the drag-and-drop builder and professionally designed templates. No coding experience is required.

Can I create unlimited popups?

Yes. You can create unlimited popup campaigns. Some advanced features are available in the Pro version.

Does YS LeadGen work with WooCommerce?

Yes. Create WooCommerce campaigns including coupon popups, exit intent offers, product recommendations, countdown promotions, free shipping announcements, upsells, cross-sells, and more.

Can I connect my email marketing platform?

Yes. YS LeadGen integrates with Mailchimp, HubSpot, Brevo, Klaviyo, Omnisend, ActiveCampaign, GetResponse, Drip, Webhooks, and more.

Is every popup mobile responsive?

Yes. Every campaign is fully responsive and optimized for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

Will YS LeadGen slow down my website?

No. The plugin is designed with performance in mind using optimized assets and lightweight frontend resources.

Can I target specific visitors?

Yes. Display campaigns based on pages, posts, products, categories, visitor behavior, user roles, devices, cookies, logged-in users, and many other targeting conditions.

Can I use AI to create campaigns?

Yes. AI-powered tools help generate popup headlines, call-to-action buttons, campaign ideas, and template recommendations to speed up campaign creation.

Is YS LeadGen translation ready?

Yes. The plugin follows WordPress internationalization standards and can be translated into your preferred language.

Where can I get support?

Documentation, tutorials, and our support team are available to help you get the most from YS LeadGen.

2.2.0

  • Refactored the Rules section for a cleaner and more flexible campaign targeting workflow.
  • Added SMTP support for form campaigns to improve email deliverability and notification reliability.

2.1.10

  • Added Activity Logs for form campaigns — track submissions, validation, reCAPTCHA, integration syncs, and webhook results in a searchable timeline.
  • Implemented CSV value and row escaping to prevent formula injection when exporting leads.
  • Added MailerLite integration for lead management.
  • Simplified product and category selection logic in WooCommerce display conditions.
  • Added coupon apply mode selection and validation in WooCommerce Coupon popups.

  • Added shareable preview links for campaigns.
  • Added AI Insights (Premium).
  • Added Kit (ConvertKit) integration.
  • Improved onboarding wizard layout and responsiveness.
